name: agent-board
description: Agent Board progress reporting: claims the card that matches this worktree/branch, writes one note per turn, and notes when the session ends (status and owner are left alone). Silent when the server is not running.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Report progress to Agent Board (/board-sync on|off overrides this)

agentBoardUrl.title: Server URL
agentBoardUrl.description: Leave empty to use AGENT_BOARD_URL, then http://localhost:4317

project.title: Project for /board-sync new
project.description: Board project new cards go to; empty = the project this repo was linked to, or one named like the repo (else /board-sync asks)

offScope.title: /board-sync off scope
offScope.description: How far /board-sync off reaches: session = this session only (back on next time), project = this repo, global = everywhere until /board-sync on
